Overview

Brownsville is a city in TX with a population of 185,000. Southernmost Texas city on the border with SpaceX and a growing aerospace sector. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.9.
